Benefactors Place Stage.title: Kathak duet
Benefactors Place Stage.description:
In this traditional Kathak duet, we bring to life the divine relationship between Radha and Krishna through three interwoven pieces: Saavan Gagana, Kanha, and Morey Piya. Each song captures a different facet of their bond—Saavan Gagana evokes Radha and Krishna together in the monsoon, Kanha portrays Krishna persuading an upset Radha, and Morey Piya celebrates their joyful dance.

Join us as we share this heartfelt journey on stage, blending music, rhythm, and movement to celebrate one of Indian culture’s most iconic love stories.

The Other FAB Theatre.title: Hold, Please
The Other FAB Theatre.description:
Hold, Please is a student-written play about living in the moment, seeing beauty in unlikely places,
and learning to breathe through the disquiet of modernity. Our lives today seem to be built in the
half-breaths between deadlines. Schedules, appointments, things to do, always rushing from
one place to another - But life isn’t just tasks on a list, it's all the bits in between. This show is a
love letter to those bits in between; staging the interactions between strangers at bus stops, lifts,
and benches in the rain and featuring a wide range of characters caught in the cross-roads
of ordinary life. It is a dream for a different tomorrow, one in which we look at the world around
us with fresh eyes, but above all, it is an appreciation for the wonders of today.

FAB Terrace.title: Tethered by Habits
FAB Terrace.description:
A living art performance tracing the quiet power in habit formation - Repetition helps anchor habits and goals until they become part of who we are. Each repeated action pulls tighter. It creates a loop around our intentions, helps us resist deviation and binds our behaviour to purpose. 
Over time, a habit is no longer a conscious task; it has become a piece of ourselves. 
Bound by threads, the performers reveal how habits can both free and confine.

My Mind’s Cacophony is my debut poetry collection, soon to be published. It offers a deeply personal and artistic exploration across a myriad of themes, including:

	•	Society and self-reflection
	•	Hope and passion
	•	Ballad-style storytelling

The title reflects a powerful interplay between lyrical thought and inner conflict, capturing my personality as both chaotic and poetic.

My mission is for readers to feel raw emotion and confront their perceptions to pause, reflect, and glimpse society through a more intimate lens.

I hope to use this platform as an exhibition of my work among those who appreciate and celebrate art and culture, while building my presence and relevance as a writer.

Avon Drama Studio.title: 'Dear Diary' - A Bridget Jones Musical
Avon Drama Studio.abstract: 30-something. Still single. Singing about it at Stagefest in Term 3, Week 8.
Avon Drama Studio.description:
Dear Diary is a musical adaptation of the iconic and beloved film Bridget Jones’s Diary. The story follows Bridget, a witty but insecure thirty-something single woman living in London, who decides to take control of her chaotic life by starting a diary. Caught in a whirlwind of romantic entanglements, she finds herself torn between the charming but unreliable Daniel Cleaver and the awkward yet unexpectedly endearing Mark Darcy. Bridget documents her disasters and triumphs in her diary, all whilst attempting to finally get her life together once and for all.

This reimagined musical version brings Bridget’s world to life through the use of pre-existing musical theatre songs, each cleverly adapted with new lyrics bringing a fresh new take to these well-known songs. Bridget remains one of the most iconic, recognisable, and relatable characters in pop culture. As university students we are all constantly trying to figure life out - navigating love, friendships, and the inevitable everyday drama that comes with growing up.

We hope this musical not only brings laughter and joy, but also resonates with anyone who has ever felt a little bit lost and frazzled… and just a little bit fabulous too.

@deardiary_mtw

The Other FAB Theatre.title: Hold, Please
The Other FAB Theatre.description:
Hold, Please is a student-written play about living in the moment, seeing beauty in unlikely places,
and learning to breathe through the disquiet of modernity. Our lives today seem to be built in the
half-breaths between deadlines. Schedules, appointments, things to do, always rushing from
one place to another - But life isn’t just tasks on a list, it's all the bits in between. This show is a
love letter to those bits in between; staging the interactions between strangers at bus stops, lifts,
and benches in the rain and featuring a wide range of characters caught in the cross-roads
of ordinary life. It is a dream for a different tomorrow, one in which we look at the world around
us with fresh eyes, but above all, it is an appreciation for the wonders of today.

Avon Drama Studio.abstract: 30-something. Still single. Singing about it at Stagefest in Term 3, Week 8.
Avon Drama Studio.description:
Dear Diary is a musical adaptation of the iconic and beloved film Bridget Jones’s Diary. The story follows Bridget, a witty but insecure thirty-something single woman living in London, who decides to take control of her chaotic life by starting a diary. Caught in a whirlwind of romantic entanglements, she finds herself torn between the charming but unreliable Daniel Cleaver and the awkward yet unexpectedly endearing Mark Darcy. Bridget documents her disasters and triumphs in her diary, all whilst attempting to finally get her life together once and for all.

This reimagined musical version brings Bridget’s world to life through the use of pre-existing musical theatre songs, each cleverly adapted with new lyrics bringing a fresh new take to these well-known songs. Bridget remains one of the most iconic, recognisable, and relatable characters in pop culture. As university students we are all constantly trying to figure life out - navigating love, friendships, and the inevitable everyday drama that comes with growing up.

We hope this musical not only brings laughter and joy, but also resonates with anyone who has ever felt a little bit lost and frazzled… and just a little bit fabulous too.

@deardiary_mtw

FAB Terrace.title: What is Folk Music? Workshop
FAB Terrace.description: Folk music is hard to define - to do so is somewhat controversial due to the genre's rich and complex history. As part of our Science of Music Module and in collaboration with Warwick Folk Society, we wanted to explore, research and educate more people on this complexity. Over the course of approx. 90-120 min, we will travel down the twisting and diverging path that is the history of folk music, exploring interdisciplinary topics such as neuroscience, anthropology, sociology and, well, music. The workshop will have sections of presentation, discussion, and the chance to learn and play some folk songs and instruments! If you already play an instrument, feel free to bring it along, and if not, we will have plenty of instruments of different skill levels for you to pick from- and if you don't want to play, don't worry, as you can still engage in the discussion sections!

Millburn House G55.title: Hold, Please
Millburn House G55.description:
Hold, Please is a student-written play about living in the moment, seeing beauty in unlikely places,
and learning to breathe through the disquiet of modernity. Our lives today seem to be built in the
half-breaths between deadlines. Schedules, appointments, things to do, always rushing from
one place to another - But life isn’t just tasks on a list, it's all the bits in between. This show is a
love letter to those bits in between; staging the interactions between strangers at bus stops, lifts,
and benches in the rain and featuring a wide range of characters caught in the cross-roads
of ordinary life. It is a dream for a different tomorrow, one in which we look at the world around
us with fresh eyes, but above all, it is an appreciation for the wonders of today.

FAB Art Gallery.title: Home
FAB Art Gallery.description:
What comes to your mind when you hear the word 'Home'? 
For the artist, it is her home country, Malaysia. Born and raised in Ampang, a city in the state of Selangor, coming to Warwick has been the longest the artist has been away from what she calls home. The usual family gatherings, the mouth-watering multi-cultural Malaysian food and the constant sight of Petronas Twin Towers in Kuala Lumpur are now thousands of miles away. To her, rediscovering home away from all the familiarity made her realise its true meaning.

FAB Art Gallery.title: A Year in a Trans Body
FAB Art Gallery.description: I have been collecting medicine packets from my HRT for several years. I have always envisioned collecting these packets and displaying them as a visual art piece, showing how much medicine a trans woman requires to feel herself every year. Likely, this would take the form of my four different medicines being presented either statically on canvas or perhaps in a pile or jumble a la Félix González-Torres "Untitled" (Portrait of Ross in L.A.).

FAB Art Gallery.title: Angry
FAB Art Gallery.description: My painting focuses on anger, particularly female anger expressed through passive aggression. Inspired by Soraya Chemaly's Rage Becomes Her, she explains how gender norms often turn female anger inwards. This exists within a flawed binary gender schema that, although increasingly challenged, still profoundly governs how we express and perceive emotion- an influence that's also intersectional, shaped further by race and class expectations.

FAB Art Gallery.title: Rubik's Cube Mosaic
FAB Art Gallery.description:
Since the early 2000s, the Rubik's cube has had a resurgence in popularity due to the presence of 'speedcubing' on social media: the act of solving the Rubik's cube and other twisty style puzzles as fast as possible. Although speedcubing is very technical, learning to solve the cube using the beginner's method is very simple, and we at the Rubik's Cube society think anyone can learn to solve one! We also want to show that art can still be made with something so associated with maths and algorithms.

This is the Rubik's Cube society's mosaic made using 100 mini Rubik's Cubes! We created this mosaic by first creating our drawing on a 30x30 grid using a paint program. We then use another program to split the picture up into 3x3 sections, corresponding to faces of a Rubik's Cube. Then we're tasked with solving  each cube to have a face the same as each 3x3 section.

FAB Art Gallery.title: The light, defined
FAB Art Gallery.description: This poem explores the struggles of unconventional, often ostracised forms of love, and the use of religion to justify bigotry and judgement. As a writer coming from a south asian country, this is a very real struggle, and love here is often kept undercover while extreme, faux displays of religious worship and 'love' are praised. Religion is subverted and true love is lost. 'The light' we have in our lives, that is the love we feel for others, is made to be put in a box, and defined. This poem has religious themes, and is not meant to criticise religion itself but the way in which religion is manipulated to fit certain beliefs of certain people.
